mutations.label: deltas: a delta needs BOTH arms, not one arm and a zero
mutations.from:
delta: withArm.length && baseline.length
          ? mean(withArm) - mean(baseline)
          : null,
mutations.to:
delta: withArm.length || baseline.length
          ? mean(withArm.length ? withArm : [0]) - mean(baseline.length ? baseline : [0])
          : null,
mutations.only: ^(?:a delta is computed within one invocation and never across two)$

mutations.label: deltas: a case that swings across invocations is called bimodal
mutations.only: ^(?:a case whose with-arm swings across invocations is reported as bimodal)$

mutations.label: deltas: no results is could-not-look, not no-effect
mutations.from: process.stdout.write(asJson ? JSON.stringify({ read: null, cases: [] }, null, 2) + '\n' : message)
mutations.only: ^(?:no results on this machine is could-not-look, never no-effect)$

mutations.label: deltas: a run that reached no answer is excluded, not scored zero
mutations.only: ^(?:a run that never reached an answer is excluded, not scored zero)$

mutations.label: deltas: an errored run is one that reached no answer
mutations.only: ^(?:a run that never reached an answer is excluded, not scored zero|an unfinished run that did not run out of turns is not called a ceiling)$

mutations.label: deltas: only a run past its own ceiling ran out of turns
mutations.only: ^(?:an unfinished run that did not run out of turns is not called a ceiling)$
